meta.title: Article Productivity of CCJ Doctoral Program Faculty

changelog.note: First public release: the data reported in the preprint and the submitted manuscript (issue years 2020-2024). It includes the corrections from the program review of v1.0 (37 programs reviewed their own lists; our team checked the other 7): faculty added or removed under the January 2025 roster rule, namesake articles removed, and missed articles added by hand. Journal weights are the published prestige ratings only (no SCImago SJR weighting). Adds the coauthorship network across programs.
Version sent privately to the 44 program directors for review; not published.
